construction.headline: (propagation - truth) along-track = +(3/4) n adot h^2, adot = mu[dA_km]/dt, n in radians per day. Derived from the two-body relation between a and n, quadratic because the error is in the modelled decay RATE.
construction.secondary: the direct linear carry of the predicted RTN offset; published beside the headline and NEVER the headline, whichever number is larger.
construction.zeroHeadIdentity: with the head zeroed the correction is identically zero at every horizon and the forecast IS plain SGP4; asserted by an offline test.

floorsPrintedFirst.note: registration 3.3: the +0 d residual is the floor and gate A4 fired in T16(b); the +1 d row is floor-limited and NO GAIN IS QUOTED THERE.

manoeuvreFreeHorizonLimit: amendment 1: the manoeuvre-free subset runs out at +14 d on Sentinel-3A/3B -- T16(b) measured n = 0 at +30 d and beyond -- and Sentinel-1A has no fetchable manoeuvre notice and therefore no manoeuvre-free arm at all. G-E2-manoeuvre-free can be discharged only at +7 d and +14 d and is UNMEASURABLE at the horizon the headline screen reads. That is a weakness of the truth set, not of the model.

population.note: Sentinel-1A's split partition is `train`. It was not among the 1,998 objects the training extraction drew, so no element set of it entered any training batch -- but that is a fact about the draw, not a guarantee from the split. It is UNSEEN IN FACT AND NOT HELD OUT BY CONSTRUCTION and never enters a headline figure.

t20Bars.note: amendment 2 A2.3: a two-spacecraft T18 figure is not strictly comparable with a three-spacecraft T20 bar, so the bar is ALSO recomputed on Sentinel-3A and 3B alone from T20's committed perObject blocks. Neither replaces the other. At +60 d and +90 d there is NO T20 BAR AT ALL and the result is UNMEASURED, never zero.

A.label: classical corrected (the bar of amendment 1 A1.1)

recomputedPerObject.note: the published pooled bars are three-object medians and cannot be re-pooled on two objects from this artefact, which carries no per-origin values. The per-object gains below are what a two-object headline is read against, and the three-object pooled bar is printed beside them.
